issue.title: lint_and_test.md and glossary:tool-run: describe inline-then-escalate (sase tool run escalation, -d, monitor start -J)

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Epic sase-1cx (inline-then-escalate ToolRuns) landed on 2026-09-30. `lint_and_test.md` and the `glossary:tool-run` strand still say agents hand off only through `sase monitor start`, and they describe check routing without `-J` escalation. Replace these sentences exactly:

**1. `lint_and_test.md`, section "Two-Speed Verification":**

- Replace: "Decide where `just check` runs before starting it: run it inline when it fits your provider's synchronous limit; for final verification, prefer a prepared-completion monitor (see your `/sase_final` skill); never cancel or rerun an in-flight check to move it to a monitor — let it finish."
- With: "Run `sase tool run check` inline: it returns before your provider's synchronous ceiling on its own, so never wrap it in `timeout` or route it to a monitor up front. If it escalates (exit `124` with an escalation block naming the still-running run), run the printed `sase monitor start -J <run-id> -p verify -n '...'` next and end the turn; the monitor finishes the same run id and nothing reruns. For final verification, prefer a prepared-completion monitor (see your `/sase_final` skill), but finish an escalated check with `-J ... -n`, not by rerunning it under `-f`. Never cancel or rerun an in-flight check."
- Replace: "`sase tool run check` itself exceeded 10 minutes in about 19% of Muse runs, so route defensively when the turn is a final gate."
- With: "`sase tool run check` itself exceeded 10 minutes in about 19% of Muse runs; it now escalates at its wait budget instead of being killed, so join the escalated run rather than routing defensively."

**2. `lint_and_test.md`, section "Run Verification Through `sase tool run`" / "Reading `sase tool run` triage":**

- Replace: "`sase tool run -H` is the non-agent hand-off (it returns at once with a run id) and refuses inside agents — agents hand off through `sase monitor start`."
- With: "`sase tool run -H` is the non-agent hand-off (it returns at once with a run id) and refuses inside agents. Inside an agent, `sase tool run -d` starts the same kind of detached run without following it, and a plain `sase tool run` detaches and follows automatically when the provider has a sync budget; either way a monitor adopts the run with `sase monitor start -J <run-id>`, and an unjoined detached run is stopped when the agent's turn ends."

**3. `lint_and_test.md`, section "PNG Snapshot Tests":**

- Replace: "Detached `sase monitor` commands drop `SASE_AGENT*` identity but set `SASE_MONITOR_ID`, which is treated the same way so a monitored local update still writes."
- With: "Detached `sase monitor` commands and detached ToolRun procs (an agent's escalated or `-d` `sase tool run`) drop `SASE_AGENT*` identity but set `SASE_MONITOR_ID` or `SASE_PROC_ID`, which are treated the same way so a monitored or joined local update still writes." (Code: `default_is_ci` in tests/ace/tui/visual/_visual_maintenance_guards.py, updated in the sase-1cx landing.)

**4. `glossary/tool-run.md` (strand `glossary:tool-run`):**

- Replace: "The execution runs in the foreground or is handed off to a monitor or proc that owns it (`sase tool run -H` outside agents, `sase monitor start` inside them); either way the run keeps one durable id that stays followable (`show -F`), waitable (`wait`), and stoppable (`stop`) until it settles to an outcome or a typed uncertainty."
- With: "The execution runs in the foreground or is handed off to a monitor or proc that owns it (`sase tool run -H` outside agents; inside them `sase monitor start`, `sase tool run -d`, or the automatic inline-then-escalate path, whose detached run a monitor adopts with `sase monitor start -J`); either way the run keeps one durable id that stays followable (`show -F`), waitable (`wait`), and stoppable (`stop`) until it settles to an outcome or a typed uncertainty."

Source of truth: docs/tool.md "Inline-then-escalate" / "Detached runs" / "Ceiling-bounded wait", docs/monitors.md (`-J/--join`), and the `sase_monitor` / `sase_final` skill sources.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1cx made agent sase tool run escalate into sase monitor start -J instead of being killed, but its plan forbade phase memory edits, so these two notes still teach the pre-escalation routing and hand-off rules.
